summary: Find installed Steam games, sort by your own ratings, and recover from a catalog update in Settings.
upgradeNotes: Keep an independent backup of your application data before upgrading.
Catalog recovery becomes available once an update replaces a saved, validated catalog snapshot.

sections.heading: 🎮 Local Steam Installation Indicators
changes: Choose your local Steam library folders in Settings to see installation evidence in Game Details.
Installation indicators work without a linked Steam account. Game Details shows installation and ownership separately.

sections.heading: Personal Game Ratings
changes: Rate a game's ease of grinding or replay appeal in Game Details, then sort the Games library by either rating.
Games can suggest ratings based on your ratings for games with similar reviewed genres. Suggestions are labeled and your own rating takes priority.

sections.heading: Catalog Recovery
changes: Restore the previous catalog from Settings when a validated snapshot is available. The restore keeps financial records, manual ownership, and saved Steam library data.
The app skips the rolled-back catalog version on later update checks.

sections.heading: Steam Sync and Catalog Updates
changes: See how many games matched your saved Steam library and why some could not be matched.
If Steam limits requests, the app waits before retrying and keeps your last successful sync available.
Catalog updates check app compatibility before applying and report when an update was skipped or could only be matched in part.

summary: Find multiplayer games more easily, browse a cleaner Games library, and explore your update history—even offline.
introduction: Version 1.4.0 introduces multiplayer filtering, an in-app release history, and several interface refinements that make Earnings Tracker easier to navigate and use.
upgradeNotes: Before upgrading, keep an independent backup of your application data.
On first launch, Earnings Tracker adds new multiplayer metadata fields to the existing game catalog. This migration preserves your financial records, ownership information, and history.

sections.heading: 🎮 Multiplayer Game Filtering
changes: Multiplayer filter — Quickly find games with reviewed multiplayer support in the Games library.
Verified information — Games with unknown multiplayer support are excluded from the filter, helping keep results relevant.
Updated catalog — The bundled game catalog now includes reviewed multiplayer information and supporting evidence.

sections.heading: 📋 In-App Release History
changes: Browse past releases and their changes without leaving the application.
View release dates and identify your currently installed version.
Access the release history even without an internet connection.

sections.heading: Cleaner Games Library
changes: Reorganized filters — Frequently used options are easier to access, while additional filters are grouped under More filters.
Smarter filter controls — Clear active filters without losing your preferred sort order or archived-game visibility.
Searchable dropdowns — Find options more easily without scrolling through long lists.
Refined game rows — Improved presentation makes game information easier to scan.

sections.heading: Interface and Usability
changes: Improved scrolling behavior for a smoother browsing experience.
Refined session controls for a cleaner interface.
Updated chart presentation for better visual consistency.

summary: Choose which sessions each payout covers and find games you already own on Steam.
upgradeNotes: Keep an independent backup of your data before upgrading. First launch adds fields for session payout assignments. Existing sessions keep their date-based treatment unless you explicitly change their assignment.

Users of v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 can check for updates in Settings. If upgrading directly from v1.0.0, follow the v1.1.0 side-by-side migration instructions and preserve the old installation and data until your records are confirmed in the new app.

sections.heading: 💰 Session Payout Assignments
changes: Assign verified sessions to Current payout or a payment marked Paid or Processing.
Preview included sessions and their combined earnings, then compare them with the recorded payment amount.
Correct historical assignments in the session editor, with each change recorded in the audit history. Historical sessions you newly verify join Current payout unless they already have an assignment.

sections.heading: 🎮 Steam Library Integration
changes: Connect your Steam profile using a personal Steam Web API key to display and filter matching games you own.
Refresh manually, or let the app check when Games opens, at most once per day. If syncing fails, your previously saved library remains available.
Set Steam Game details to Public for reliable syncing. Steam ownership stays separate from manual ownership and purchase costs.
Your API key is stored in Windows Credential Manager and excluded from backups. Your linked Steam account ID and cached library information are included in backups.

sections.heading: Financial Information and Feedback
changes: Clearer earnings summaries, payout coverage previews, payment differences, and session import results.
Simpler Settings and update messages, with bookmark labels that describe the available action.

sections.heading: Games and Game Pass Details
changes: Cleaner Games and Game Details layouts use shorter Game Pass descriptions. Last-checked dates, expiration dates, and stale-availability warnings remain visible.

summary: Explore your earnings, find sessions, and browse games through a redesigned interface.

sections.heading: 📊 Redesigned Analytics Dashboard
changes: Review verified earnings trends, session statuses, time played, and top earning games.
Keep earnings, balance, and payout information within reach.

sections.heading: Sessions Explorer
changes: Browse a compact session table with search, sorting, and filters for game, status, and date.
Open session details to inspect or edit a record, or navigate to its related game. The list handles large histories without displaying every row at once.

sections.heading: Games Library and Navigation
changes: Browse and search games in a more compact layout, with clearer earning rates, availability, sorting, and filters.
Use ownership information, bookmarks, archived games, and saved browsing preferences.
Review session edits through more consistent save and cancel controls, with existing validation and audit protections.

sections.heading: About This Update
changes: This is a visual and usability update. Earning calculations and existing financial records stay the same. Online catalog updates and Steam integration are not part of this release.

summary: Keep your data separate from the app, manage backups in Settings, and import sessions more reliably.
upgradeNotes: If you use version 1.0.0, install this version separately. The update button in version 1.0.0 cannot install it because Windows treats it as a different app.

Before upgrading from 1.0.0, close the old app and keep a separate backup. Install the new version alongside it. On first launch, the new app copies and checks the records and backups it can transfer, keeping the originals. Check your history and backups in the new app before relying on it. Keep the old app closed, and do not uninstall or repair it until you have confirmed your data is safe.

sections.heading: 🗂️ Separate Application and Data Folders
changes: Application files use %LOCALAPPDATA%\EarningsTracker.App. Personal data and backups use the separate %LOCALAPPDATA%\EarningsTracker.UserData folder.
Repairing or reinstalling the app does not require replacing its database. First launch can copy and verify eligible old records and backups while retaining the originals.

sections.heading: Database Backup and Restore
changes: Create a database backup or begin a confirmed restore in Settings.
The app validates the backup, asks for confirmation, and preserves a recovery copy of your current data before replacement. Restart to complete the restore.

sections.heading: Games Library Preferences
changes: Games remembers your sort order, bookmarks-only filter, and archived-game visibility between launches.
Initial defaults are Newest sorting, bookmarks-only off, and archived games visible.

sections.heading: Session Imports and Editing
changes: Improved coordination of overlapping imports and protection against outdated previews creating duplicates or overwriting newer results.
Added checks for session edits whose underlying records change before saving, with better handling of database conflicts and locking.

sections.heading: Startup and Updates
changes: Improved handling of initialization, locked files, and migration errors helps the app stop when startup cannot continue safely.
Application updates use full packages on the new win-x64-app-stable channel. Game Details → Add Session imports remain unavailable in this release.

summary: Track your Nerve gaming sessions, verified earnings, and payouts in one Windows app.

sections.heading: 📊 Earnings at a Glance
changes: View verified earnings, recent sessions, and daily totals on Dashboard.
Check each game's earning rate, earning cap, and your progress toward it.
Explore your earnings history and compare your activity over time in Statistics.

sections.heading: Sessions and Payments
changes: Import sessions from Nerve's Recordings page, check verification statuses, and review ambiguous game matches.
Track payments, bonuses, corrections, and adjustments that add to or subtract from your earnings. Game Details session imports are not available in this release.

sections.heading: Application Updates
changes: Check for and download updates in Settings, then restart when you are ready. Game catalog updates are handled separately.
This version uses the original win-x64-stable application update channel.

sections.heading: About This Version
changes: The first stable release runs on 64-bit Windows, includes what it needs to run, and stores your tracking records locally on your computer.
